name: stack-launch-film
description: Stack launch film: a Remotion project built from the app's own tokens and Build geometry. Isolated from the app runtime.

scripts.render:16x9: node scripts/assets.mjs && node scripts/sfx.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts StackLaunchLandscape out/stack-launch-16x9.mp4
scripts.still: node scripts/assets.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts StackLaunch out/still.png
scripts.stills: node scripts/assets.mjs && node scripts/sfx.mjs && node scripts/stills.mjs
scripts.render:silent: node scripts/assets.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts StackLaunch out/stack-launch-9x16-silent.mp4 --props='{"format":"vertical","sfx":false}'
